claim_text: Our climate actions are focused on positioning our portfolio for the energy transition, reducing our operational GHG emissions, supporting emissions reduction across our value chain, and strengthening our physical climate resilience.
metric_name: Operational emissions FY25 vs FY24; Scope 3 emissions FY25 vs FY24
context_text: Our climate actions are focused on ... reducing our operational GHG emissions ... and strengthening our physical climate resilience.；In FY25, total operational emissions increased by approximately 2% year-on-year.；In FY25, Scope 3 emissions totalled 22.7 Mt CO2-e, 58% lower than FY24 levels.；We have developed our first Climate Adaptation and Resilience Plan.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 报告可证明South32在价值链减排和气候韧性方面有行动与披露，但FY25运营排放总量同比上升2%，因此对“reducing our operational GHG emissions”的整体表述只能部分支撑。
notes: 同一气候叙事中存在局部进展与总量上升并存。
